Commercial Battle License 3 Rank

Veteran Agent ▶ You are here!
Master Agent
Great Agent
==================================
Papaya Guide: uwo.papayaplay.com/uwo.do?tp=news.view&postid=2355
==================================

Do you want to be an Agent?

1. Check the required conditions.

1) Court Rank: 10R(5th Knight) or higher.
2) Royal Fleet: You should be one of Royal Fleet members.
(Go to your Palace and meet the Count or similar NPC to join Royal Fleet)
3) Relationship with All Other Nations!: shoulbe be "Normal" or better!
--------------------------
Note: Relationship with other nations
Warning > Hostile > Enmity > Distrust > Alert > Normal >
Amity > Goodwill > Trust > Affection > Sworn Allies
---------------------------

2. Meet "Commercial Battle Secretary"(at your Palace, Home City) and obtain "Commercial Battle License(CBL)" => You are now an Commercial Battle License Holder, Agent.
=> Your IGN color will be changed into "green", "Agent" mark will be carved in your toon.

3. Advantages

1) You can donate 5m to City Official a day,
and can get Donation Appreciation Exchange Ticket (No.1) 5 pcs.
2) can obtain "Merit"s via Adventures/Trades/Sea Battles(Commercial Activities) etc.
3) can increase your Agent Rank. (Merits will be accumulated.)
4) Rewards (depends on your CBL Rank)

Fifth Rank Merit Reward (No.1)
Fourth Rank Merit Reward (No.1)
Third Rank Merit Reward (No.1)
Second Rank Merit Reward (No.1)
First Rank Merit Reward (No.1)

4. Disadvantages

1) Agents can be attacked by other agents from Different nations in the Hostile Water.
2) You have to report "Commercial Battle Activities" to "Commercial Battle Secretary" or City Official periodically.
